facts.value: Resolves the supplied fighter GObj, clears cmd_vars[1], and stores the first globally listed FTKIND_MASTERH GObj, or NULL, returned by ftBossLib_GetFighterGObj in Fighter.x1A5C. It forwards the original GObj and fixed arguments to Fighter_ChangeMotionState for numeric state 0x17B, then calls ftAnim_8006EBA4. The animation callback later consumes and resets cmd_vars[1] and clears x1A5C on termination; its partner predicates independently query global fighters rather than dereference this stored reference.
facts.rationale: Corrects the obsolete lookup-helper spelling and distinguishes stored-reference lifetime from independent partner queries.

evidence.why: Current entry data flow and animation cleanup.
Independent global queries, first matching fighter lookup and NULL fallback.
